gaps.title: Missing closed strains application layer and access control
gaps.jtbd: When I query closed strains, I want the system to filter access based on my Moodle department and courses, so that access restrictions are automatically enforced.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a user authenticated via Moodle, When they request closed strains, Then the system only returns strains matching their department or courses.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'Автоматическое разграничение прав доступа к закрытым штаммам'. The application codebase completely lacks any API endpoints or logic to query or restrict access to strains.

gaps.title: Dossier signature right incorrectly bound to department instead of role
gaps.jtbd: When I attempt to sign a dossier, I want the system to verify my role, so that only an Epidemiologist or Admin can sign.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a user with the EPIDEMIOLOGIST role, When they submit a signature for a dossier, Then the system accepts it. Given a user without the role, Then the system denies it.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'Старший научный сотрудник / Эпидемиолог с правом подписи досье'. EmployeeDossierController.signDossierReport checks if department equals 'Эпидемиология' instead of checking if the user role is EPIDEMIOLOGIST.
